PROC UNIVARIATE

Source: vignettes/articles/guide-proc-univariate.Rmd
guide-proc-univariate.Rmd
library(sasonr)

PROC UNIVARIATE describes the distribution of numeric variables: moments, basic measures of location and variability, tests for location, quantiles and extreme observations.

res <- sas_run("
options nocenter;
data vitals;
  input sbp @@;
  datalines;
128 124 135 131 118 121 140 126 133 119
;
run;
proc univariate data=vitals;
  var sbp;
run;
")
cat(res$listing, sep = "\n")
